# Hand Mirror

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Hand Mirror
- **Artist / Maker:** Egyptian
- **Date:** New Kingdom, Dynasty 18 (about 1550–1295 BCE)
- **Style / Period:** new kingdom
- **Classification:** mirror
- **Department:** Arts of Africa
- **AIC artwork ID:** 835
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/835
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/84bb4f73-a115-eacc-6299-d646d4e10208/full/400,/0/default.jpg
